name: Basic PDF Conversion
description: Template for converting documents to PDF format with configurable options

parameters.name: sourceFile
parameters.description: Path or name of the source document to convert

parameters.name: headerText
parameters.description: Text to display in the page header

parameters.name: footerText
parameters.description: Text to display in the page footer

parameters.name: includeToc
parameters.description: Whether to include a table of contents
